==Description==
The '''Strong Mummy''' was an [[Enemies|enemy]] that appeared in [[Nightmare Carnival]] as part of the [[Halloween 2019 Event]]. Compared to the [[Mummy (Nightmare Carnival)|Mummy]], it had more health, but was slower. It could also be spawned by the [[Jack O' Bot]] and [[Reaper (Nightmare Carnival)|Reaper]].

==Appearance==
Similar to the [[Mummy (Nightmare Carnival)|Mummy]], the '''Strong Mummy''' was wrapped around with bandages, which covered most of its body, exposing only some of its arms and its head. However, the bandages were slightly darker compared to the [[Mummy (Nightmare Carnival)|Mummy]]. Its torso and legs were white. It had dark-ish green skin and was faceless.

==Strategy==
*Early on, [[Soldier]]s or [[Paintballer]]s can help clear through '''Strong Mummies''' quite easily.
**This is favorable while you save up for better towers for the stronger [[enemies]] that debut later in [[Nightmare Carnival]].
*As they spawn in hordes, splash damage towers such as the [[Demoman]] and [[Rocketeer]] can be very useful.
*[[Minigunner]]s and [[Ranger|Outlaws]] can easily clear out hordes of '''Strong Mummies'''. However, you will need to save up cash in order to afford them early on.
*If you already have the [[Shredder]], it can be helpful in defeating it.

==Trivia==
*The '''Strong Mummy''' had the same appearance as the [[Mummy (Nightmare Carnival)|Mummy]], but it was just slightly darker.
